open_points: 1. The references at 1101-1104 are in phase 1 and the kit checks no B10/B11 pin for them (only the second phase's seeds): a missed 1104 re-pin is still a pod-side crash (G4 kind). Smallest fix: run second_phase_gate's re-pin check (B10 reference_units naming the seed's source COMPLETE.json; B11 accepting it) for every reference job at release (1101-1103 against REJUDGED_PINS' Gate A units, 1104 against block A's a0_arm). Not built (outside K1-K6). Block A's a0@1104 has no K6 record (it ran before this round); main now holds scripts/stage1_s1/extract_a0_fingerprint.py (the re-pin round's 1104 route, not read by this round).

2. Re-packing X for the second phase while a phase-1 X host could still be deferred or requeued: the new host is bound to the X2 digest and no route re-binds it (D11). Keep the X2 folder aside and swap it back to launch such a host, or re-pack only after phase-1 X hosts are settled.
3. A pending host's jobs are decided all together (its pod runs every job it holds); no route drops one job from a held host.

4. Behaviour change for every block but A: a job that a defer/requeue left behind without re-running it (contingency exhausted) now keeps the block open until a not-run decision or a user re-run payment; before, the block was complete without any record of it. Block C (plan B only) gets the same rule and route.
5. K3 needs this round's runner on the certification pod: a complete b10_certify record without certification_gate refuses at record-done. An old runner's crashed exit-4 record is not converted.
6. K4: the whole-group need assumes one launch at a time (§28 stated limit with the guard off).

7. The second phase reads B10/B11 settings from the main checkout at S1_CODE's pins: the re-pin must be merged in main's scripts/ and S1_CODE re-taken before its release (the live dry run's step 6 refused exactly so: main's working copy 18287cfa... vs this TREE's a99f918f...).
8. Two complete a0 attempts at a second-phase seed (an environment-mismatch re-run) refuse the release; the lead decides which unit B10 pins.
9. The first mutation run took about 9 minutes in the foreground, above the 8-minute guideline; the ALL spec is left for the lead's background job.
